# Milestone 6 (part): the calibration section under the GSS design (generated by summarise.py)

241 cells (pair x item) over 20 pairs; 931 pair x item x n rows, each over the run's simple random calibration subsamples. Ultimate-cluster (with-replacement PSU) variances with GSS strata and PSUs; 1972-74 rows (no design codes) are their own PSUs.

## Against the population share, by calibration subsample size n

V1 = design variance of the full target sample's share (common to M and D); V2 = phase-2 variance over subsamples around the sample share. total ratio = (V1 + V2_D)/(V1 + V2_M). inflation = sqrt((V1 + V2_D) / mean Kish interval variance of D), the factor by which m6_calibration's D intervals are too narrow for the population share. design est / target = mean over draws of the designer-computable design variance of D over V1 + V2_D; Kish est / target the same for the Kish variance.
